title: Al-Sharaa Issues Decree Revising Customs Law, Reinforcing Ban on Israeli Goods
detail: Syrian transitional President Ahmad al-Sharaa issued a presidential decree revising Syria's Customs Law, explicitly reinforcing the existing prohibition on importing goods of Israeli origin. The move maintains an economic policy stance held since the Assad era — continuing the Arab League boycott framework — even as Syria pursues diplomatic normalization with Western states and sanctions relief from the US and EU. The decree underscores tensions inherent in Syria's new governance: while al-Sharaa seeks international rehabilitation and investment, he is also consolidating sovereign policy positions, including on Israel, where Syria's transitional government has consistently objected to ongoing IDF strikes and Israeli occupation of expanded Golan buffer zones.

title: Car Bomb Explosion in Damascus Kills at Least One Person
detail: A vehicle-borne explosion in Damascus killed at least one person, according to reports from the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights (SOHR) and local monitors. The attack occurred amid ongoing instability in the capital as security forces of the transitional government continue to establish control. Separately, Internal Security Forces blocked a protest by makeshift oil refinery owners in Aleppo from marching on Saadallah Al-Jabiri Square. The Aleppo protest reflects growing economic grievances among informal-sector workers whose livelihoods are under threat from regulatory changes as the transitional government attempts to formalize Syria's chaotic wartime economy. Isolated bombings and security incidents remain a feature of the transition period despite the absence of large-scale military operations.
